aim: Cross-size check of the 4B channel diagnosis on the same 20 exposed pages. The original six-page error subgroup is frozen by the 4B mixed-context baseline. Test the observed direction that attention has larger median contribution than recurrent state on the full cohort and the six error pages. gate: Both attention medians must exceed their corresponding recurrent medians to support replication; also report every component and 9B free answers. Continue a native rescue only under original 4-of-6 native page rule.
budget: Up to 12 min for locally cached 4-bit 9B. Original public datasets and all 48 reserved pages unchanged.
